# EXP-007 tuning log (generated by src/run_sweep.py)

Baseline: siamese_diff, depth 2, batch 32, AdamW lr 3e-4, cosine, 15 epochs, BCE + 0.3 x CE. Noise band (4 identical runs): val AUC 0.884-0.896. Verdict rule: better only if val AUC > 0.905; worse if < 0.879. Selection uses validation only; test is shown for reference.

| phase | run | change | why | val AUC | test D2 AUC | unseen font AUC | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| phase1 | sd_base_s1 | baseline, seed 1 | measure run-to-run noise before judging any change | 0.884 | 0.880 | 0.925 | noise measurement |
| phase1 | sd_base_s2 | baseline, seed 2 | measure run-to-run noise before judging any change | 0.887 | 0.830 | 0.912 | noise measurement |
| phase1 | sd_aug | mild augmentation (brightness, blur, noise) | baseline over-fits after ~6 epochs; extra camera-like noise may regularise | 0.896 | 0.884 | 0.918 | no measurable difference |
| phase1 | sd_drop_wd | dropout 0.3 + weight decay 1e-3 | classic regularisation against the over-fitting seen in the baseline | 0.893 | 0.864 | 0.929 | no measurable difference |
| phase1 | sd_freeze | frozen first conv + layer1 | fewer trainable weights = less over-fitting; low-level ImageNet filters may be enough | 0.845 | 0.792 | 0.848 | worse |
| phase1 | sd_depth1 | encoder depth 1 (1/4 resolution) | re-spacing is missed; finer feature maps keep more position detail | 0.905 | 0.854 | 0.922 | better |
| phase1 | sd_depth3 | encoder depth 3 (1/16 resolution) | opposite check: does more 'meaning' help glyph/font swaps despite coarser positions? | 0.877 | 0.865 | 0.898 | worse |
| phase1 | sd_focal | focal loss (gamma 2) | obvious tampers are learned fast; focal loss puts weight on the hard, subtle ones | 0.875 | 0.868 | 0.930 | worse |
| phase1 | sd_kind0 | no 'which tamper' loss | does the auxiliary 8-class task help or distract the yes/no task? | 0.898 | 0.886 | 0.930 | no measurable difference |
| phase1 | sd_kind1 | 'which tamper' loss weight 1.0 | same question from the other side: a stronger auxiliary task | 0.888 | 0.861 | 0.927 | no measurable difference |
| phase1 | sd_lr1e-4 | learning rate 1e-4 | val AUC peaks early then drops; a slower learning rate may peak later and higher | 0.854 | 0.825 | 0.921 | worse |
| phase2 | sd_depth1_s1 | encoder depth 1, seed 1 | depth 1 was the only setting at the edge of the noise band (0.905): repeat before believing it | 0.913 | 0.857 | 0.934 | better |
| phase2 | sd_depth1_s2 | encoder depth 1, seed 2 | as above | 0.920 | 0.892 | 0.917 | better |
| phase3 | ef_base | early_fusion architecture (6-channel ResNet-18) | compare architectures with the same baseline settings | 0.902 | 0.858 | 0.878 | no measurable difference |
| phase3 | dino_base | dino_frozen architecture (frozen DINOv2 + head) | compare architectures; frozen backbone may over-fit less | 0.783 | 0.752 | 0.815 | worse |
| phase4 | sd_more | baseline + data/synth_more (~4x training pairs) | the baseline over-fits after ~6 epochs on 2k pairs; more data is the most direct fix | 0.940 | 0.949 | 0.928 | better |
| phase4 | sd_depth1_more | depth 1 + data/synth_more | best phase-1 setting, with the extra data | 0.950 | 0.943 | 0.951 | better |
| phase5 | sd_depth1_bin_s0 | depth 1, yes/no loss only (no 8-class task), seed 0 | pure 2-class training, with the best setting | 0.907 | 0.878 | 0.926 | better |
| phase5 | sd_depth1_bin_s1 | depth 1, yes/no loss only, seed 1 | as above (second seed) | 0.907 | 0.843 | 0.934 | better |
| phase6 | norvia_448 | NORVIA only, 448x128, depth 1, batch 16 | control for the resolution run (and shows whether dropping the font set D1 changes NORVIA results) | 0.950 | 0.918 | n/a (NORVIA only) | better |
| phase6 | norvia_896 | NORVIA only, 896x256 (full resolution), depth 1, batch 16 | half-size crops turn 1-2 px tampers into sub-pixel changes; full resolution keeps them | 0.962 | 0.921 | n/a (NORVIA only) | better |
